notes.title: Update 3.38
notes.content: [p]New things added this update:[/p][p][/p][p]-New OST for perks page and boxing gym ambiance for training. [/p][p]-Sanctioned fights now allow a rank difference up to 4. [/p][p]-New fighters added – Pillow Fist Haney, Paulie Negitiviti, Ivan Drogo [/p][p]-More boxer face and body skins, [/p][p]-New main title screen for wide screens. [/p][p]-General UI enhancements.[/p]

notes.title: Update 3.37 Ring Blood
notes.content: [p]A small update that adds blood that spreads around the ring over the course of a fight.[/p][p]I've been busy lately and unable to work on the game! But should have more time soon![/p][p][/p][p]Now go smash someone's face in[/p]

notes.title: Update 3.31
notes.content: [list][*][p]Bugfix: apply accuracy and efficiency punch perks to 'Professional Skills"[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: apply punch talents to 'Professional Skills"[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update 3.30
notes.content: [p]-Bugfix: Exiting a hot-seat sparring match before the first bell saved the fight as "in progress" in the campaign[/p][p]-Bugfix: "Liver Shot" was not correctly getting modified by some perks[/p][p]-Bugfix: "Liver Shot" was missing "Body Snatcher" energy drain tooltip[/p][p]-Bugfix: Fight log printed wrong fighter's name when a punch into guard broke the guard[/p][p]-Bugfix: Fight log printed wrong fighter's name when "Impenetrable Guard" triggered[/p][p]-Bugfix: "Rope a Dope" worked against "Liver Shot"[/p][p]-Bugfix: Show base hit chance for "Professional Skills"[/p][p]-Bugfix: Legendary boxers had all perks available after resetting perks[/p][p]-Prevent "Legendary" perk from getting wiped on perk reset[/p][p]-Reword Lightweight perk description for clarity[/p][p]-Critical knockdown injuries are now relevant to the punch thrown (these happen when a punch damages an opponent such that they would have less than -15 health)[/p][p]-Add new boxer skins[/p][p]-Add option to resurrect or leave legendary boxers dead when re-generating roster[/p][p]-Add new perks: "Pain Rage", "Pain Clarity"[/p]

notes.title: Update 3.29
notes.content: [p]Small update to address cheesing the ai and perk balance.[/p][p][/p][p]- AI: Improve bot decision making in fights (specifically when cornered by a fighter with guard up and countering)[/p][p]- Manny Pacmeow gains "southpaw" perk[/p][p]- Legendary boxer's "legendary" perk no longer counts towards their perk total[/p][p]- "Fast Fist" now ignores "Peek a Boo"[/p][p]- "Glory in Death" reduces injury debuff by 30% when badly injured[/p][p]- Add audio cues when rolling boxers (the higher pitched tone the better the fighter)[/p]

notes.title: Simulate fights between any two boxer!
notes.content: [h2]Turn Based Boxing [/h2][p]The playtest is ending and the game is now released! Thanks for all your support! I will continue to support the game however, and add and fix things as we go![/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="xtHcwR6LAgQ;full"][/previewyoutube][h1]Simulate Fights[/h1][list][*][p]You can now simulate fights between any two fighter, even ones that are not in your gym.[/p][/*][*][p]If the two fighter's are too far apart in rank, it will be a sparring match, otherwise it may be a fully sanctioned fight that goes on their record.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You can import boxer strings right into simulated fights, and they will be added to your game after the fight.[/p][/*][*][p]2 player hot seat is now available for sparring matches[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]More Details on update 3.26[/b][/h2][p]- Update AI to generally be smarter, AI now uses professional skills  [/p][p]- Make boxers face each other when they switch sides  [/p][p]- Bugfix: Simulate Fights red corner was not picking a strategy in the first round  [/p][p]- Bugfix: Un-counterable straights were counterable by "peek-a-boo" and "anger"  [/p][p]- Bugfix: Sometimes, AI would double side step, wasting an action  [/p][p]- Bugfix: Patch boxer creator glitch that allowed male and female fighters to have the opposite gender's perk  [/p][p]- Add "show more" btn to Simulate Fight Page  [/p][p]- Add drop downs to select existing fighters in Simulate Fight  [/p][p]- Add toggle for sparring fight when simulating fights (won’t count on record or risk death)  [/p][p]- Rename injuries of organs that cannot be "broken" to "hemorrhaged"  [/p][p]- KO punch now ends the fight instantly with no count  [/p][p]- Show healing and energy recovery amounts when choosing a corner action  [/p][p]- Slightly increase counter punch damage  [/p][p]- Add a few new boxer faces  [/p][p]- Add new Legendary boxers: Sugar Ray Leopard, George Forehead, Lennox Loose-screws, Oscar De La Yayo, Joy Bones Jr.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Playtest now accepting players!
notes.content:
[h1]The steam playtest is now live![/h1]

[h2]If you want to join, please click the Join Playtest button on the steam page.[/h2]

[h3][b]Submit feedback / bugs[/b] to the steam discussion, or on my [url=https://discord.com/invite/Tr7yVM7ust]discord server[/url] [/h3]

[h2][b]Here are some new things added for this playtest.[/b][/h2]
 [list]
[*] Add basic shortcut keys to quickly access action categories in a fight. 
[*] Add "Dirty Mouth" perk (this is a rare and hidden perk that makes the boxer's swear and cuss) I might remove this..
[*]AI improvements - make them smarter
[*]Fix boxer generation perks selection bug: Reset roster recommended (Opponents were getting to many perks to early)
[*]Fix bug where logs showed wrong boxer name when countering.
[*]Perks balancing
[*]Remove base plate (chair) from fighter inside the ring
[*]Train quickly with 5x and 10x training buttons
[*]Recover stamina when getting up from a knock down
[*]Add "undertaker perk" (effects knock down recovery stamina gain)
[*]Allow 0% injury chance (disable death)

[/list]

notes.title: Added "Combos", New perks, Boxer Faces, and Legendary Fighters
notes.content:
Added now to the demo:

Legendary fighters are fightable and at the top of the rankings, as well as a few custom easter egg boxers scattered around the roster. (more soon)

Added more perks, 1 for each punch type that boosts accuracy.
Added 'Awkward" perk

Added "Combos".

Here is a list of combos:

[b]Injure Boost[/b]
bodyshot > straight = injure + 10
bodyshot > uppercut = injure + 25
bulldoze > hook = injure + 10
bulldoze > straight = injure + 5
bulldoze > uppercut = injure + 20
hook > straight = injure + 5
hook > uppercut = injure + 15
jab > body = injure + 10
straight > body = injure + 10
uppercut > straight = injure + 10
uppercut > uppercut = injure + 20

opponent ended their turn with lungs > bodyshot = injure + 25

[b]Damage Boost[/b]
bodyshot > hook = damage + 5
bulldoze > bodyshot = damage + 7
guard > hook = damage + 3
guard > straight = damage + 2
hook > hook = damage + 5
jab > jab = damage + 5
move > body = damage + 5
move > hook = damage + 8
shove > jab = damage - 6
straight > jab = damage + 5
upper > body = damage + 8
split guard > straight = damage + 9

[b]Hit Chance[/b]
bodyshot > feint = chance + 25
bodyshot > split = chance + 20
bulldoze > feint = chance + 20
clinch > bodyshot = chance + 20
clinch > hook = chance + 10
clinch > upper = chance + 20
counter > feint = chance + 10
feint > body = chance + 5
feint > feint = chance + 30
feint > jab = chance + 5
feint > split guard = chance + 25
feint > straight = chance + 5
guard > jab = chance + 5
jab > feint = chance + 20
jab > straight = chance + 10
jab > split = chance + 15
move > jab = chance + 5
move > straight = chance + 10
shove > feint = chance + 20
shove > jab = chance + 20
straight > hook = chance + 10
upper > hook = chance + 15
split guard > jab = chance + 20


Also fixed several bugs.
